_comment: Native components Playroom ships that npm can't report: the engine's linked libraries and Rust crates, the AI runtime and model, and ExifTool. Read by scripts/third-party-notices.mjs; `license` names a text in build/licenses/. Keep in step with pixl-engine's Cargo.lock and its release build, and with scripts/fetch-ai.mjs and the engine's ci/onnxruntime.json.

components.name: libheif
components.use: HEIC and AVIF files, shipped as a separate shared library (the engine's platform package)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) Dirk Farin, struktur AG and the libheif contributors

components.name: libde265
components.use: HEVC decoding for HEIC, shipped as a separate shared library
components.copyright: Copyright (c) struktur AG, Dirk Farin and the libde265 contributors

components.name: libaom
components.use: AV1 for AVIF files, shipped as a separate shared library
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2016, Alliance for Open Media. All rights reserved.

components.name: libjxl
components.use: JPEG XL files, linked into the engine
components.copyright: Copyright (c) the JPEG XL Project Authors. All rights reserved.

components.name: libjpeg-turbo
components.use: JPEG files, linked into the engine
components.copyright: Copyright (c) the libjpeg-turbo Project authors. This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

components.name: libwebp
components.use: WebP files, linked into the engine
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2010, Google Inc. All rights reserved.

components.name: Little CMS
components.use: colour management, linked into the engine

components.name: rawler
components.use: camera RAW decoding and DNG writing, linked into the engine
components.copyright: Copyright (c) Daniel Vogelbacher and the dnglab contributors
components.note: Statically linked. LGPL-2.1 section 6 obligations for a statically linked library are under review (see TODO.md).

components.name: jpegxl-sys
components.use: Rust bindings to libjxl, linked into the engine
components.note: Under review (see TODO.md): a GPL component in a proprietary binary.

components.name: Other Rust crates in PIXL Engine
components.use: the engine's remaining dependencies (png, tiff, fast_image_resize, weezl, image, and others), under MIT, Apache-2.0 and similar permissive licences
components.copyright: Copyright (c) their respective authors; see each crate's page on crates.io
components.note: A complete per-crate list will come from the engine's own release build (see TODO.md).

components.name: ONNX Runtime
components.use: runs the AI models, shipped as a separate shared library in the engine's platform package; its own notices follow in full

components.name: ExifTool
components.use: reads and writes metadata (run as a separate program, through exiftool-vendored)
components.licenseName: the same terms as Perl itself (Artistic License or GNU GPL)

components.name: Electron and Chromium
components.use: the application runtime; Chromium's own notices are in LICENSES.chromium.html beside the application
components.copyright: Copyright (c) Electron contributors. Copyright (c) 2013-2020 GitHub Inc.
